leaky_backpack.name: Leaky Backpack
leaky_backpack.notes: Each water leak event loses extra 1 L unless waterproof bag carried.

fragile_shoelaces.name: Fragile Shoelaces
fragile_shoelaces.notes: First boot lace snap causes HP -1 unless duct tape carried.

cold_sensitive.name: Cold Sensitive
cold_sensitive.notes: Cold-related events extra 1 HP loss; down jacket cancels 1.

heat_resistant.name: Heat Resistant
heat_resistant.notes: Hot weather and sun events 1 HP better.

climber.name: Climber
climber.notes: Slip or fall events 1 HP better.

allergy_prone.name: Allergy Prone
allergy_prone.notes: Bee sting and insect events extra 1 HP unless allergy medicine.

old_batteries.name: Old Batteries
old_batteries.notes: First headlamp dead causes HP -1 if no spares.

hot_drink_lover.name: Hot Drink Lover
hot_drink_lover.notes: Hot drink events give +1 extra HP with stove + pot.

clean_freak.name: Clean Freak
clean_freak.notes: First scavenged food event extra -1 HP without disinfectant.

water_hoarder.name: Water Hoarder
water_hoarder.notes: If carrying >5L water, suffer HP -1 per day.

light_pack_expert.name: Light Pack Expert
light_pack_expert.notes: If total weight <=15 kg, recover HP +1 each night.

repair_expert.name: Repair Expert
repair_expert.notes: Equipment damage events 1 HP better with repair kit.

night_walker.name: Night Walker
night_walker.notes: Night/darkness events 1 HP better with headlamp.

coffee_bonus.name: Coffee Bonus
coffee_bonus.notes: First fatigue/headache event becomes HP 0 with coffee press + stove.

picky_eater.name: Picky Eater
picky_eater.notes: Raw/uncooked food events always extra -1 HP.

backup_hammock.name: Backup Hammock
backup_hammock.notes: If no tent/tarp on rainy nights, exposure reduced by 1 HP.

old_rope.name: Old Rope
old_rope.notes: First cliff/river crossing event extra -1 HP without rope/tool kit.
